review_status: Source links checked; Rwanda agronomic review pending

fao_maize_handling.title: FAO: Inspection, sampling and analysis of maize and groundnuts for aflatoxin
fao_maize_handling.scope: General maize handling guidance; local operating limits need agronomist confirmation.

likhayo_2018.title: Likhayo et al. (2018): Maize grain stored in hermetic bags (FAO AGRIS record)
likhayo_2018.evidence_type: Experimental study abstract indexed by FAO AGRIS
likhayo_2018.scope: One hot, dry site; results are not a Rwanda-specific effectiveness estimate.

fao_fresh_packaging.title: FAO: Small-Scale Postharvest Handling Practices, packing and packaging materials
fao_fresh_packaging.scope: General fresh-produce guidance applied to tomato as a candidate practice; local trials needed.

interventions.title: Check moisture and drying before storage
interventions.action: Measure grain moisture; dry wet maize before storage and protect it from rewetting.
interventions.when_to_consider: A field check finds wet grain or inadequate drying.
interventions.check_first: Verify the storage moisture limit with the agronomist and intended storage system.
interventions.evidence_summary: FAO identifies moisture control before storage as a central mould-prevention measure.

interventions.title: Assess hermetic storage for adequately dried maize
interventions.action: Evaluate intact hermetic bags once grain dryness is verified.
interventions.when_to_consider: Storage insect losses are confirmed and dry grain can be maintained.
interventions.check_first: Confirm moisture, bag integrity, handling training and local affordability; do not seal wet grain.
interventions.evidence_summary: A maize experiment found protection for dry grain, but wetter grain developed more discolouration. Its findings require local validation.

interventions.title: Inspect shelling damage
interventions.action: Review sheller operation and grain condition to reduce kernel breakage.
interventions.when_to_consider: Inspection identifies broken kernels associated with shelling.
interventions.check_first: Check moisture and equipment settings with a trained operator.
interventions.evidence_summary: FAO connects wet-grain shelling and high sheller speed with kernel damage, which can contribute to mould problems.

interventions.title: Assess protective, ventilated packaging
interventions.action: Trial clean, sturdy, ventilated crates and avoid overfilling or loose packing.
interventions.when_to_consider: A field check finds bruising or compression damage during packing and stacking.
interventions.check_first: Compare handling, cleaning, availability and reuse costs with existing packaging.
interventions.evidence_summary: FAO guidance favours rigid protection and ventilation for fresh produce, with careful fill levels to limit bruising.
